cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hand Over the Proof
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender information, evidence, a key, or access that would let you proceed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Give me the actual note, not your description.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can read it to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I want the words that don't get your emphasis.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me the one line you're using to decide for me.

mechanism: A directs what source material must be surrendered and narrows the demand only after B invokes privacy.
confusable: Unlike accepting a summary, A insists on unmediated access to the exact line used to decide for A.
comparison: A private note and selective access differ from a club-account key and shared responsibility.
seedUse: The seed already commands access and rejects mediated reading; S01's authority is exercised in the final narrowed instruction.
